hypothesis: The sign of an ETF's 12-month return minus the T-bill return predicts the sign of its excess return next month (Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen 2012); the long-short portfolio adds alpha to the reference book at 2x cost.

rationale.VTI: US equity, the passive-core equity leg
rationale.IEF: intermediate Treasuries, the passive-core bond leg
rationale.TLT: long Treasuries, the largest duration exposure
rationale.BIL: cash leg: T-bill proxy for the excess-return signal and the parking asset; never traded as a signal asset

signal: For each non-cash ETF, the sign of the trailing 12-month return minus the BIL return at month-end. Positive is long, negative is short. Weights are inverse-volatility, scaled to a 10% annual portfolio volatility target. Rebalance monthly; fills per plan/execution.md.

holdout.rule: seen-window: the 2016-2026 holdout was already seen by an earlier long-only trend test; the report is labeled seen-window and the shadow gate minimum is 6 rebalances

open_questions: decision.min_net_sharpe: the plan requires the 95% bootstrap CI lower bound above 0 and states no numeric floor; 1e-06 stands for 'above 0'.
decision.min_days: the plan states no minimum evaluation length for the backtest gate; 1 is a placeholder (MinTRL is computed by the harness).
split.n_splits: the plan states no walk-forward split count; 2 is the validator minimum.
split.label_horizon_days: 21 is one monthly holding period in sessions; the plan gives no number.
split.embargo_days: the plan gives no number; 0 is a placeholder. Labels overlap by at most one month.
holdout.end: the plan says 2016-2026 without a date; the drafting date is used.
variants: the plan allows at most 2 ETF Trend trials and names none; long_short is the published rule and long_only is the control for the short side.
universe: the plan says about 10 ETFs and names none; the 9 listed are a proposal.
decision.max_drawdown_pct: 20 is the plan default of 2x the 10% volatility target; confirm no stricter limit.
